1.title: For Some in a Disrupted D.C., Grand Prix Is More Irritation Than Celebration
1.summary: Race preparations have snarled traffic, rerouted flights and forced the National Gallery of Art to conduct vibration tests.

2.title: Police Chief in Mississippi Regularly Used Racist Slurs, Private Text Messages Reveal
2.summary: Text exchanges obtained by reporters show troubling messages sent by the chief of a Mississippi police department facing an uproar over the fatal shooting of a 1-year-old boy in June.

3.title: How a Progressive Democrat in Florida Gave Her Party New Hope — and New Fears
3.summary: Angie Nixon, a state lawmaker from Jacksonville, shocked Democrats in red Florida by soundly defeating her centrist primary opponent. Now comes the hard part.

4.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' strike
4.summary: Nine people are still missing after the attack which left 130 injured, including a number of children.

5.title: What Does Harry and Meghan’s Return to England Mean for Their Children?
5.summary: One effect of moving back is that Archie and Lilibet now have the opportunity to be schooled as Britons. Here’s what that might look like.

6.title: Carney Stands Up to Trump in U.S.-Canada Trade War
6.summary: Canada’s prime minister walked away from what he thought was a bad trade deal with the United States. Many Canadians are behind him, but it will be costly.
